page.title: 依頼は、何枚オブラートを重ねる？

analysis.summaryJa: 依頼表現は、動詞原形の命令からPlease、Can you、Could you please、Would you mind + -ingへ進むほど、相手に断る余地や心理的距離を残しやすくなる。このページでは単なる『丁寧語の暗記』ではなく、相手との距離、依頼の負担、場面の改まり方に応じて依頼の層を選び、各表現固有の文型を正しく使うことを中心に40問へ展開した。
grammarPoints: 命令文は動詞原形で始まり、Please + 動詞原形で礼儀を加えられる
Can you + 動詞原形は身近な相手への一般的な依頼に使える
Could you please + 動詞原形は心理的距離を取り、より丁寧な依頼になる
Would you mind + 動名詞(-ing)は相手の意向や負担への配慮を強く示す
依頼の丁寧さは相手との関係、依頼の負担、サービス場面などの文脈で選ぶ
Would you mind not + -ingで『〜しないでいただけますか』という依頼も作れる
visualEvidence: Open the case → Please open the case → Can you open the case? → Could you please open the case? → Would you mind opening the case? という丁寧さの段階
『強い→やわらかい』という方向で透明な層を重ねる図
駅で見知らぬ人に頼むミニ問題でCan youよりCould you pleaseを選び、距離とpleaseを重ねる説明
『丁寧さは、相手に選ぶ余地を渡すこと』というまとめ
commonTraps: Would you mindの後ろに動詞原形やto不定詞を置く
Could you pleaseの後ろを過去形や-ing形にする
Can youを能力の事実だけと捉え、依頼としての用法を見落とす
初対面や負担の大きい依頼で、直接命令だけを選び文脈上不自然になる
Would you mind not + -ingのnotの位置を誤る

questions.prompt: ------- send me the updated visitor list before noon, please.
questions.translationJa: 正午までに更新済みの来訪者リストを送ってもらえますか。
questions.explanationJa: 依頼では Can you + 動詞原形 を使えます。You can は許可・能力の陳述になり、依頼の形ではありません。

questions.prompt: For a request to a client you have not met, ------- please confirm your arrival time?
questions.translationJa: まだ会ったことのない取引先への依頼として、到着時刻をご確認いただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: 距離のある相手には Could you please + 原形 が自然で丁寧です。
questions.focus: Could you please の丁寧な依頼

questions.prompt: Would you mind ------- the conference room door while the interview is in progress?
questions.translationJa: 面接中、会議室のドアを閉めていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: Would you mind の後ろには動名詞 -ing を置くので closing が正解です。

questions.prompt: ------- the package at reception when you arrive.
questions.translationJa: 到着したら荷物を受付に置いてください。
questions.explanationJa: Please を付けた命令文は Please + 動詞原形 で作るため Please leave が正解です。

questions.prompt: ------- you check whether the projector is connected before the guests enter?
questions.translationJa: 来客が入る前に、プロジェクターが接続されているか確認してもらえますか。
questions.explanationJa: Can you + 原形は、相手の能力・意思を尋ねる形を使った一般的な依頼です。

questions.prompt: Would you mind ------- me a copy of the signed agreement?
questions.translationJa: 署名済み契約書の写しを送っていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: mind は目的語として動名詞を取るため sending が必要です。

questions.prompt: ------- you please lower your voice near the recording studio?
questions.translationJa: 録音スタジオの近くでは声を少し落としていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: 丁寧な依頼は Could you please + 動詞原形 で表せます。

questions.prompt: The receptionist said, “------- wait here for a moment while I call the manager.”
questions.translationJa: 受付係は「部長に電話する間、ここで少々お待ちください」と言いました。
questions.explanationJa: Please の直後に wait という原形が続く命令文です。ほかの選択肢は依頼表現の形が誤っています。
questions.focus: Please を使う丁寧な命令

questions.prompt: When asking a colleague for a small favor, ------- you open the shared calendar for me?
questions.translationJa: 同僚にちょっとしたお願いをするとき、「共有カレンダーを開いてもらえる？」と言えます。
questions.explanationJa: Can you + 原形は、身近な相手への自然な依頼です。

questions.prompt: For the most considerate option here, ------- switching seats so the guest can sit near the aisle?
questions.translationJa: ここで最も配慮した言い方なら、お客様が通路側に座れるよう席を替えていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: Would you mind + -ing は相手の負担や意向に配慮する柔らかい依頼です。
questions.focus: 丁寧さと Would you mind

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct request to a coworker.

choices.A: Can you sending the invoice today?
choices.B: Can you send the invoice today?
choices.C: Can you to send the invoice today?
choices.D: Do you can send the invoice today?

questions.translationJa: 今日、請求書を送ってもらえますか。
questions.explanationJa: Can you の後ろには動詞原形 send を置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct polite request at a hotel front desk.

choices.A: Could you please to call a taxi for me?
choices.B: Could please you call a taxi for me?
choices.C: Could you please calling a taxi for me?
choices.D: Could you please call a taxi for me?

questions.translationJa: タクシーを呼んでいただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: Could you please + 動詞原形 call が正しい語順と形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using “mind.”

choices.A: Would you mind moving your bag from this seat?
choices.B: Would you mind to move your bag from this seat?
choices.C: Would you mind move your bag from this seat?
choices.D: Would you mind moved your bag from this seat?

questions.translationJa: この席からバッグを移していただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: Would you mind の後ろは動名詞 moving です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct request in an office notice.

choices.A: Please to return the key before 6:00.

questions.translationJa: 6時までに鍵を返却してください。
questions.explanationJa: Please を使う命令文では動詞原形 return を続けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that is both grammatical and suitable for a routine favor between colleagues.

choices.A: Can you to check this figure once more?
choices.B: Can you check this figure once more?
choices.C: Can you checked this figure once more?
choices.D: Can checking you this figure once more?

questions.translationJa: この数値をもう一度確認してもらえますか。
questions.explanationJa: 同僚への普通の依頼には Can you check ...? が自然で、動詞は原形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the best sentence for a courteous request to an unfamiliar visitor.

choices.A: Can you please to sign here?

questions.translationJa: こちらにご署名いただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: 初対面の相手には Could you please + 原形 が丁寧で自然です。
questions.focus: 距離のある相手への依頼

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence asking someone to reduce a minor inconvenience.

choices.A: Would you mind to turn down the screen brightness?
choices.B: Would you mind turn down the screen brightness?
choices.C: Would you mind turning down the screen brightness?
choices.D: Would you mind turned down the screen brightness?

questions.translationJa: 画面の明るさを下げていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: mind の補語は動名詞 turning です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that gives a polite but direct instruction.

choices.A: Please keep your receipt until the refund is processed.
choices.B: Please keeping your receipt until the refund is processed.
choices.C: Please to keep your receipt until the refund is processed.
choices.D: Please kept your receipt until the refund is processed.

questions.translationJa: 返金処理が終わるまで領収書を保管してください。
questions.explanationJa: Please + 動詞原形 keep で、直接的だが礼儀正しい指示になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the most considerate request for interrupting someone who is working.

choices.B: Can you opening the file for me?
choices.C: Please you open the file for me.
choices.D: Would you mind opening the file for me when you have a moment?

questions.translationJa: お手すきのときに、そのファイルを開いていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: Would you mind + -ing に when you have a moment を加えることで、相手の都合に配慮した依頼になります。
questions.focus: 相手への選択余地を残す依頼

questions.prompt: Choose the correct request using “could.”

choices.A: Could you please to forward the message?
choices.B: Could you please forward the message?
choices.C: Could you please forwarded the message?
choices.D: Could you forwarding the message, please?

questions.translationJa: そのメッセージを転送していただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: Could you please の後ろは原形 forward です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Please send the revised agenda today.”

choices.A: You sent the revised agenda today.
choices.B: Would you mind to send the revised agenda today?
choices.C: Could you send the revised agenda today?
choices.D: You can send the revised agenda today.

questions.translationJa: 今日、改訂版の議題を送ってもらえますか。
questions.explanationJa: Please + 原形の依頼は、Can/Could you + 原形の依頼へ言い換えられます。ここではCould you send ...? が自然です。
questions.focus: Please依頼とCould you依頼の対応

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Could you please show me where the meeting room is?”

choices.A: Would you mind showing me where the meeting room is?
choices.B: You must show me where the meeting room is.
choices.C: Showed me where the meeting room is.
choices.D: Would you mind to show me where the meeting room is?

questions.translationJa: 会議室がどこにあるか教えていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: Would you mind showing ...? は同じ内容をより相手への配慮を込めて依頼する形です。
questions.focus: 丁寧な依頼の言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Would you mind waiting outside for a few minutes?”

choices.A: You have to wait outside for a few minutes.
choices.B: Could you waited outside for a few minutes?
choices.C: Please waiting outside for a few minutes.
choices.D: Could you please wait outside for a few minutes?

questions.translationJa: 外で数分お待ちいただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: Would you mind waiting ...? は Could you please wait ...? と同様に丁寧な依頼を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Can you check the reservation number for me?”

choices.A: You can checking the reservation number for me.
choices.B: Please check the reservation number for me.
choices.C: Would you mind to checked the reservation number?
choices.D: You checked the reservation number for me.

questions.translationJa: 予約番号を確認してください。
questions.explanationJa: Can you check ...? という依頼は、Please check ... と内容上対応します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Please lower the blinds before the presentation.”

choices.A: The blinds were lower before the presentation.
choices.B: You must lowered the blinds before the presentation.
choices.C: Could you lower the blinds before the presentation?
choices.D: Would you mind to lower the blinds before the presentation?

questions.translationJa: プレゼンの前にブラインドを下げてもらえますか。
questions.explanationJa: Please lower ... は Could you lower ...? という依頼に自然に言い換えられます。
questions.focus: 命令形から依頼疑問文への言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Could you please speak a little more slowly?”

choices.A: Would you mind speaking a little more slowly?
choices.B: Would you mind to speak a little more slowly?
choices.C: You speak a little more slowly yesterday.
choices.D: Can you speaking a little more slowly?

questions.translationJa: もう少しゆっくり話していただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: Would you mind + -ing は Could you please + 原形 と同様に、相手に配慮した依頼を表せます。
questions.focus: 丁寧な依頼の等価表現

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Would you mind emailing the receipt to me?”

choices.A: Emailing the receipt to me is required.
choices.B: Could you to email the receipt to me?
choices.C: You emailed the receipt to me.
choices.D: Could you please email the receipt to me?

questions.translationJa: 領収書をメールで送っていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: Would you mind emailing ...? と Could you please email ...? は、どちらも丁寧な依頼です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Can you carry this box to the storage room?”

choices.A: You are able carrying this box to the storage room.
choices.B: Please carry this box to the storage room.
choices.C: Would you mind to carry this box to the storage room?
choices.D: You carried this box to the storage room.

questions.translationJa: この箱を倉庫まで運んでください。
questions.explanationJa: 依頼としての Can you carry ...? は Please carry ... と同じ行為を相手に求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Please do not block the entrance.”

choices.B: Would you mind to not blocking the entrance?
choices.C: Would you mind not blocking the entrance?

questions.translationJa: 入口をふさがないでいただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: Would you mind not + -ing で『〜しないでいただけますか』という丁寧な依頼になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Could you please give me a moment to review the figures?”

choices.B: Would you mind to give me a moment?
choices.C: You can give me a moment yesterday.
choices.D: Would you mind giving me a moment to review the figures?

questions.translationJa: 数値を確認する時間を少しいただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: Would you mind giving ...? は Could you please give ...? と同じく丁寧に時間を求める依頼です。
questions.focus: 丁寧な依頼の意味保持

questions.prompt: You are writing to a hotel you have never contacted before. “I will arrive after 10 p.m. ------- please keep my reservation until midnight?”
questions.translationJa: これまで連絡したことのないホテルへのメールです。「午後10時以降に到着します。午前0時まで予約を保持していただけますか。」
questions.explanationJa: 初めて連絡する相手への丁寧な依頼には Could you please + 原形 が適切です。
questions.focus: 初対面・距離のある相手への依頼

questions.prompt: The technician is concentrating on a repair. You need one small favor but do not want to pressure her. “------- moving your toolbox slightly to the left?”
questions.translationJa: 技術者は修理に集中しています。負担をかけずに小さなお願いをします。「工具箱を少し左へ動かしていただけますか。」
questions.explanationJa: 相手の作業を中断させる場面では Would you mind + -ing が配慮を示します。
questions.focus: 相手の負担に配慮する依頼

questions.prompt: A team leader gives a simple routine instruction during setup: “------- place the name cards beside each seat.”
questions.translationJa: チームリーダーが準備中に簡単な手順を伝えます。「各席の横に名札を置いてください。」
questions.explanationJa: 日常的な業務指示なら Please + 動詞原形 が簡潔で自然です。

questions.prompt: You ask a close coworker for a quick check. “------- you confirm the room number on this booking?”
questions.translationJa: 親しい同僚に簡単な確認を頼みます。「この予約の部屋番号を確認してもらえる？」
questions.explanationJa: 親しい同僚への小さな依頼には Can you + 原形 が自然です。

questions.prompt: At an information desk, a traveler politely asks a stranger for help. “------- telling me which platform the express train leaves from?”
questions.translationJa: 案内所で旅行者が見知らぬ人に丁寧に尋ねます。「特急がどのホームから出るか教えていただけますか。」
questions.explanationJa: Would you mind の後ろには telling のような動名詞を置き、相手への配慮を表します。

questions.prompt: The office is very cold, and you want to make a polite request to the facilities clerk. “Could you please ------- the temperature by two degrees?”
questions.translationJa: オフィスがとても寒いため、施設担当者に丁寧に頼みます。「温度を2度上げていただけますか。」
questions.explanationJa: Could you please の後ろは動詞原形 raise です。

questions.prompt: A customer is waiting while you search for her order. You say, “------- give me just a moment while I check the system.”
questions.translationJa: 注文を調べる間、顧客に「システムを確認しますので、少々お待ちください」と伝えます。
questions.explanationJa: Please + 動詞原形 give は、サービス場面で丁寧かつ簡潔な依頼になります。

questions.prompt: Your colleague is about to leave for the airport. You want a favor only if it is convenient. “------- picking up the brochures on your way out?”
questions.translationJa: 同僚が空港へ出発するところです。都合がよければ頼みたいので、「出るついでにパンフレットを取ってきてもらえますか」と尋ねます。
questions.explanationJa: 相手の都合を尊重する文脈では Would you mind picking up ...? が自然です。

questions.prompt: A supplier has sent the wrong attachment twice. You still want to remain courteous: “------- you please resend the price list as a PDF?”
questions.translationJa: 仕入先が誤った添付を2度送っていますが、礼儀を保って「価格表をPDFで再送いただけますか」と依頼します。
questions.explanationJa: 不満がある場面でも Could you please + 原形 を使えば丁寧な依頼になります。
questions.focus: 丁寧さを保つCould you please

questions.prompt: The lights are too bright during a presentation. You quietly ask the person beside the switch, “------- the front lights a little?”
questions.translationJa: プレゼン中に照明が明るすぎるため、スイッチのそばの人へ小声で「前方の照明を少し暗くしていただけますか」と頼みます。
questions.explanationJa: Would you mind + -ing を使うので Would you mind dimming ...? が正しい丁寧な依頼です。
